quarterly_data.quarter: Wuxi Taclink Optoelectronics results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual (04-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman and general manager Qu Jianping (2025 annual results briefing): the overseas R&D and production base project (the Thailand plant) was delayed because the company carefully optimised some equipment selection and configurations to fit future market needs, lengthening equipment selection and purchasing decisions; plant construction is complete and fit-out is nearly finished, equipment purchasing is being accelerated, and the Thailand plant is expected to start trial production in April 2026 and formal production in June once all equipment is in place.
quarterly_data.figure: Thailand plant trial production April 2026; formal production June 2026
